name: cmd-sentence
description: One terminal command split into its parts of speech: the verb (the program), its options and its objects (arguments), each with a coloured underline and a short label, plus an optional plain-English reading.

title.description: small label above the command, e.g. `Another sentence`

role.description: verb: the program to run; option: how; object: what it acts on

label.description: a short label under the word, e.g. `verb · list`

focus.description: light one role and fade the others

gloss.description: markdown-lite: the command read as plain English
